story.en: Tuesday afternoon at Airbnb's Trust & Operations team. A sync bug between two calendar providers let a handful of listings get booked twice for overlapping dates before the fix shipped. The reservations table has one row per booking, and a few long-term stays were entered with no checkout date at all — the guest hadn't set one yet, meaning the stay was still open-ended, not a data-entry mistake. Before support can reach out to double-booked guests, every pair of reservations on the same listing whose stay dates actually overlap needs to be found — same-day turnovers, where one guest checks out exactly as another checks in, are normal and shouldn't be flagged.
story.ta: Tuesday afternoon Airbnb-oda Trust & Operations team-la. Rendu calendar providers-kkidaiyila oru sync bug, fix varara munnadi konjum listings overlapping dates-kku rendu murai book aaga vidichirukku. reservations table-la ovvoru booking-kkum oru row irukku, konjum long-term stays-kku check-out date-e illama enter panniyirukkanga — guest innum onnu set pannala, andha stay innum open-ended-a irukku-nu artham, data-entry mistake illa. Double-booked guests-a support contact panna munnadi, same listing-la irukkura, real-a overlap aagura reservations pairs ella-vayum kandupidikkanum — oru guest checkout aagura date-la vera guest check-in aagura same-day turnovers normal, flag pannakoodadhu.
story.hi: Tuesday afternoon Airbnb ke Trust & Operations team mein. Do calendar providers ke beech ek sync bug ne, fix aane se pehle kuch listings ko overlapping dates ke liye do baar book hone diya. reservations table mein har booking ke liye ek row hai, aur kuch long-term stays check-out date ke bina hi enter hui thi — guest ne abhi tak set nahi kiya tha, matlab stay abhi bhi open-ended hai, data-entry mistake nahi. Double-booked guests ko support se contact karne se pehle, same listing par jitne bhi reservation pairs genuinely overlap karte hain unhe dhoondna hai — jahan ek guest checkout hote hi dusra check-in kare wo normal same-day turnover hai, flag nahi hona chahiye.
story.te: Tuesday afternoon Airbnb Trust & Operations team lo. Rendu calendar providers madhya oka sync bug, fix vachevaraku konni listings ni overlapping dates ki rendu sarlu book avvanichindi. reservations table lo prathi booking ki oka row untundi, konni long-term stays check-out date lekunda enter chesaru — guest inka set cheyaledu, aa stay inka open-ended ga undi ani ardham, data-entry mistake kaadu. Double-booked guests ni support contact cheyadaniki mundu, same listing meeda nijamga overlap ayye reservations pairs anni kanugonali — oka guest checkout ayye roju vere guest check-in ayye same-day turnovers normal, flag cheyakudadu.

question.en: Find every pair of reservations for the same listing whose stay dates genuinely overlap — not reservations that simply share a listing, and not back-to-back turnovers where one checkout date equals the next check-in date. Treat a NULL check_out as an open-ended stay that hasn't ended yet (it overlaps with any later reservation on that listing). Return each overlapping pair once (not twice, and never a reservation paired with itself) as listing_id, guest_1, check_in_1, check_out_1, guest_2, check_in_2, check_out_2, sorted by listing_id then guest_1.
question.ta: Same listing-kku irukkura, real-a stay dates overlap aagura ella reservations pairs-a-yum kandupidunga — listing mattum share pannura reservations illa, matrum oru checkout date adutha check-in date-kku equal-a irukkura back-to-back turnovers-um illa. NULL check_out-a innum mudiyaadha open-ended stay-a treat pannunga (andha listing-la adutha edhu vandhaalum adhoda overlap aagum). Ovvoru overlapping pair-a-yum oru murai mattum return pannunga (rendu murai illa, matrum oru reservation adhoda thanoda pair aaga koodadhu) listing_id, guest_1, check_in_1, check_out_1, guest_2, check_in_2, check_out_2-a, listing_id apparam guest_1 order-la sort pannunga.
question.hi: Same listing ke liye, jinke stay dates genuinely overlap karte hain aise sabhi reservation pairs dhoondo — sirf listing share karne wale reservations nahi, aur wo back-to-back turnovers bhi nahi jinme ek checkout date agle check-in date ke barabar ho. NULL check_out ko ek open-ended stay maano jo abhi khatam nahi hui (wo us listing par baad mein aane wale kisi bhi reservation se overlap karti hai). Har overlapping pair ko sirf ek baar return karo (do baar nahi, aur koi reservation khud ke saath pair na ho) listing_id, guest_1, check_in_1, check_out_1, guest_2, check_in_2, check_out_2 ke roop mein, listing_id phir guest_1 ke order mein sort karke.
question.te: Same listing ki, nijamga stay dates overlap ayye anni reservations pairs ni kanugonandi — kevalam listing share chese reservations kaadu, mariyu oka checkout date next check-in date ki equal ga unna back-to-back turnovers kuda kaadu. NULL check_out ni inka avvani open-ended stay ga treat cheyandi (aa listing meeda tarvata vache e reservation tho aina adi overlap avutundi). Prathi overlapping pair ni oka sari matrame return cheyandi (rendu sarlu kaadu, mariyu e reservation dani tanu tanu pair avvakudadu) listing_id, guest_1, check_in_1, check_out_1, guest_2, check_in_2, check_out_2 ga, listing_id tarvata guest_1 order lo sort chesi.

title.en: Look at the raw reservations, grouped by listing
title.hi: Raw reservations ko, listing ke hisaab se dekho
title.te: Raw reservations ni, listing prakaram chudandi

en: reservations has one row per booking, not one row per listing — listing_id repeats whenever the same property has more than one reservation; here 100 and 300 each have more than one.
Divya's reservation on listing 300 has NULL check_out — she's still staying, with no checkout date recorded yet, which is different from a data gap; it means 'not ended,' not 'unknown.'

Listing 100 has three reservations back to back: Aarav ends 08-05 exactly when Karthik begins, which is a normal same-day turnover, not a double-booking — that boundary case is exactly what the final query needs to get right.
Nothing is compared yet — this step only confirms which listings even have more than one reservation to check.
ta: reservations-la ovvoru booking-kkum oru row irukku, oru listing-kku oru row illa — same property-kku onnukku mela reservation irundhaal listing_id repeat aagum; inga 100 matrum 300 rendukkum onnukku mela irukku.

Listing 300-la Divya-oda reservation-la check_out NULL-a irukku — avanga innum stay panniturukanga, checkout date innum record aagala, idhu data gap-la irundhu vera; idhu 'not ended' nu artham, 'unknown' illa.

Listing 100-kku moondru reservations back-to-back irukku: Aarav 08-05-la end aagum, Karthik andha exact date-la thaan start aaguraaru, idhu normal same-day turnover, double-booking illa — indha boundary case-a dhaan final query correct-a solve pannanum.
Innum edhuvum compare pannala — indha step edhavadhu listing-kku check panna onnukku mela reservation irukkanu mattum confirm pannum.
hi: reservations mein har booking ke liye ek row hai, har listing ke liye ek row nahi — jab bhi ek hi property ke paas ek se zyada reservation ho, listing_id repeat hota hai; yahan 100 aur 300 dono ke paas ek se zyada hai.

Listing 300 par Divya ke reservation mein check_out NULL hai — wo abhi bhi ruki hui hai, koi checkout date abhi record nahi hui, jo ek data gap se alag hai; iska matlab hai 'not ended,' 'unknown' nahi.

Listing 100 mein teen reservations ek ke baad ek hain: Aarav 08-05 ko khatam hota hai, thik usi din Karthik shuru hota hai, jo ek normal same-day turnover hai, double-booking nahi — yeh boundary case hi hai jise final query ko sahi karna hai.
Abhi kuch compare nahi hua — yeh step sirf yeh confirm karta hai ki kis listing ke paas check karne ke liye ek se zyada reservation hai.
te: reservations lo prathi booking ki oka row untundi, prathi listing ki oka row kaadu — ade property ki oka dani kante ekkuva reservation unnappudu listing_id repeat avutundi; ikkada 100 mariyu 300 rendintiki oka dani kante ekkuva unnayi.
Listing 300 meeda Divya reservation lo check_out NULL undi — aame inka staying, checkout date inka record avvaledu, idi data gap kanna veru; idi 'not ended' ani ardham, 'unknown' kaadu.

Listing 100 ki mudu reservations back-to-back unnayi: Aarav 08-05 ki end avutadu, ade roju Karthik start avutadu, idi normal same-day turnover, double-booking kaadu — ee boundary case ni e final query correct ga handle cheyali.
Inka emi compare avvatledu — ee step e listing ki check cheyadaniki oka dani kante ekkuva reservation undo matrame confirm chestundi.

title.en: Self-join reservations to their own table to build every same-listing pair
title.ta: Same-listing pair ovvondrayum build panna reservations-a adhoda own table-oda self-join pannunga
title.hi: Har same-listing pair banane ke liye reservations ko khud ke table se self-join karo
title.te: Prathi same-listing pair build cheyadaniki reservations ni dani own table tho self-join cheyandi

steps.sql:
SELECT r1.listing_id,
       r1.guest_name AS guest_1,
       r2.guest_name AS guest_2
FROM reservations r1
JOIN reservations r2
  ON r1.listing_id = r2.listing_id
 AND r1.reservation_id < r2.reservation_id
ORDER BY r1.listing_id, r1.guest_name;

en: A self-join is just an ordinary JOIN where both sides come from the same table — reservations is aliased as r1 and r2 so each row can be matched against every other row from the same table, not just against itself.

r1.listing_id = r2.listing_id keeps the join to pairs on the same property — without it, every reservation would get paired with every other reservation across all listings, most of which have nothing to do with each other.

r1.reservation_id < r2.reservation_id does two jobs at once: it stops a reservation from being joined to itself (r1.reservation_id = r2.reservation_id would always match with an = condition), and it keeps each pair to a single row instead of two mirror-image rows (Aarav-Priya and Priya-Aarav).

Listing 200's two reservations (Meera and Rohan) show up here even though their actual stay dates don't overlap at all — this step only finds candidates that share a listing; it doesn't check dates yet.
ta: Self-join nu solradhu, rendu side-um same table-la irundhu varum ordinary JOIN dhaan — reservations r1 matrum r2 nu alias pannirukku, so ovvoru row-um same table-la irukkura ella vera rows-oda-vum match pannalaam, adhu thanoda mattum illa.

r1.listing_id = r2.listing_id, join-a same property-la irukkura pairs-kku mattum vachirukkum — idhu illama, ella reservation-um ella listings-ilyum irukkura vera ella reservation-oda-vum pair aagum, adhula palavum onnukum onnu sambandham illama irukkum.

r1.reservation_id < r2.reservation_id rendu vElai onnaa seiyum: oru reservation adhoda thanoda join aaguradha nikkum (= condition-la r1.reservation_id = r2.reservation_id eppavum match aagum), matrum ovvoru pair-a-yum oru row-a mattum vachirukkum, rendu mirror-image rows (Aarav-Priya matrum Priya-Aarav) illama.

Listing 200-oda rendu reservations (Meera matrum Rohan) inga varum, avanga actual stay dates onnume overlap aagaadhu na kooda — indha step listing share pannura candidates-a mattum kandupidikkum; date check innum pannala.
hi: Self-join sirf ek ordinary JOIN hai jahan dono sides same table se aate hain — reservations ko r1 aur r2 ke naam se alias kiya gaya hai, taaki har row ko usi table ki har doosri row se match kiya ja sake, sirf khud se nahi.

r1.listing_id = r2.listing_id join ko same property par hone wale pairs tak seemit rakhta hai — iske bina, har reservation sabhi listings ki har doosri reservation ke saath pair ho jaata, jinme se zyadatar ka ek doosre se koi lena-dena nahi hota.

r1.reservation_id < r2.reservation_id ek saath do kaam karta hai: yeh ek reservation ko khud se join hone se rokta hai (= condition mein r1.reservation_id = r2.reservation_id hamesha match karega), aur har pair ko ek hi row tak seemit rakhta hai, do mirror-image rows (Aarav-Priya aur Priya-Aarav) ki jagah.

Listing 200 ke do reservations (Meera aur Rohan) yahan dikhte hain, bhale hi unki actual stay dates bilkul overlap na karti hon — yeh step sirf un candidates ko dhoondta hai jo listing share karte hain; date check abhi nahi hoti.
te: Self-join ante rendu sides ade table nunchi vache ordinary JOIN matrame — reservations ni r1 mariyu r2 ga alias chesaru, so prathi row ade table lo unna prathi itara row tho match avvachu, dani tanu tanu matrame kaadu.

r1.listing_id = r2.listing_id join ni ade property meeda unna pairs ki matrame unchutundi — idi lekunda, prathi reservation anni listings lo unna prathi itara reservation tho pair avutundi, andulo cala vatiki okadanikokati em sambandham undadu.

r1.reservation_id < r2.reservation_id rendu panulu okate chestundi: idi oka reservation danini tanu tanu join avvakunda aputundi (= condition lo r1.reservation_id = r2.reservation_id eppudu match avutundi), mariyu prathi pair ni oka row ki matrame unchutundi, rendu mirror-image rows (Aarav-Priya mariyu Priya-Aarav) kakunda.

Listing 200 rendu reservations (Meera mariyu Rohan) ikkada kanipistayi, vaalla actual stay dates em overlap avvakapoyina kuda — ee step listing share chese candidates ni matrame kanugontundi; date check inka avvatledu.

title.en: Keep only pairs whose stay dates actually overlap
title.ta: Real-a stay dates overlap aagura pairs-a mattum vachirukkunga
title.hi: Sirf un pairs ko rakho jinki stay dates asal mein overlap karti hain
title.te: nijamga stay dates overlap ayye pairs ni matrame unchandi

steps.sql:
SELECT r1.listing_id,
       r1.guest_name AS guest_1, r1.check_in AS check_in_1, r1.check_out AS check_out_1,
       r2.guest_name AS guest_2, r2.check_in AS check_in_2, r2.check_out AS check_out_2
FROM reservations r1
JOIN reservations r2
  ON r1.listing_id = r2.listing_id
 AND r1.reservation_id < r2.reservation_id
WHERE r1.check_in < COALESCE(r2.check_out, '9999-12-31')
  AND r2.check_in < COALESCE(r1.check_out, '9999-12-31')
ORDER BY r1.listing_id, r1.guest_name;

en: Two stays overlap exactly when each one starts before the other one ends — r1.check_in < r2.check_out AND r2.check_in < r1.check_out. Using strict < on both sides means a checkout date equal to the next check-in date does not count as overlapping, which is why Aarav and Karthik (08-05 to 08-05) correctly get excluded even though they're both candidates from the self-join.

COALESCE(check_out, '9999-12-31') stands in for 'no end date yet' with a date far enough in the future to never accidentally be earlier than a real check-in — that's what lets Divya's open-ended stay correctly overlap with Vikram's reservation three weeks later, instead of being silently dropped by a NULL comparison.

Listing 200 disappears from the result entirely: Meera (08-01 to 08-03) and Rohan (08-10 to 08-15) were a candidate pair after the self-join, but Rohan's check-in isn't before Meera's checkout, so the WHERE clause correctly filters them out as a non-overlap.

Three overlapping pairs come out of seven reservations across three listings: Aarav/Priya and Priya/Karthik on listing 100 (a three-way pileup, but reported as two separate pairs, not one group), and Divya/Vikram on listing 300 — each reported exactly once, in the order the self-join's inequality guaranteed.
ta: Rendu stays exact-a overlap aaguradhu eppo-nu na, ovvondrum vErondru mudiyara munnadi start aana pothu — r1.check_in < r2.check_out AND r2.check_in < r1.check_out. Rendu side-ilyum strict < use pannradhu na, checkout date adutha check-in date-kku equal-a irundhaal overlap-a count aagaadhu, adhaan Aarav matrum Karthik (08-05 to 08-05) self-join-la rendu perum candidates-a irundhaalum correct-a exclude aaguranga.

COALESCE(check_out, '9999-12-31'), 'innum end date illa' nu solradhukku, future-la romba dooram irukkura date-a use pannum, adhu edhavadhu real check-in-kku munnadi accidental-a varaadhu — idhu dhaan Divya-oda open-ended stay-a, moondru weeks kazhichu varura Vikram-oda reservation-oda correct-a overlap panna vidum, NULL comparison-la silent-a drop aagama.

Listing 200 result-la irundhu completely maraiyum: Meera (08-01 to 08-03) matrum Rohan (08-10 to 08-15) self-join-kku apparam oru candidate pair-a irundhanga, aana Rohan-oda check-in, Meera-oda checkout-kku munnadi illa, so WHERE clause avangala non-overlap-a correct-a filter pannidum.

Moondru listings-la irukkura ezhu reservations-la irundhu moondru overlapping pairs varum: listing 100-la Aarav/Priya matrum Priya/Karthik (moondru-vazhi pileup, aana onnu group-a illama rendu thani pairs-a report aagum), matrum listing 300-la Divya/Vikram — self-join-oda inequality guarantee panniyapadi ovvondrum exact-a oru murai report aagum.
hi: Do stays tabhi genuinely overlap karti hain jab har ek doosri ke khatam hone se pehle shuru ho — r1.check_in < r2.check_out AND r2.check_in < r1.check_out. Dono side par strict < use karne ka matlab hai ki agle check-in date ke barabar checkout date overlap nahi maani jaayegi, isiliye Aarav aur Karthik (08-05 se 08-05) self-join se dono candidates hone ke bawajood sahi se exclude ho jaate hain.

COALESCE(check_out, '9999-12-31'), 'abhi tak koi end date nahi' ke liye future mein itni door ki date use karta hai ki wo galti se bhi kisi real check-in se pehle na aaye — yehi Divya ki open-ended stay ko, teen hafte baad aane wali Vikram ki reservation ke saath sahi se overlap karne deta hai, NULL comparison se chupke se drop hone ki jagah.

Listing 200 result se poori tarah gayab ho jaata hai: Meera (08-01 se 08-03) aur Rohan (08-10 se 08-15) self-join ke baad ek candidate pair the, lekin Rohan ka check-in Meera ke checkout se pehle nahi hai, isliye WHERE clause unhe non-overlap maankar sahi se filter kar deta hai.

Teen listings ki saat reservations mein se teen overlapping pairs nikalte hain: listing 100 par Aarav/Priya aur Priya/Karthik (ek three-way pileup, lekin ek group ki jagah do alag pairs ke roop mein report hota hai), aur listing 300 par Divya/Vikram — self-join ki inequality ne jaisa guarantee kiya, waise hi har ek exactly ek baar report hota hai.
te: Rendu stays exact ga overlap ayye appudu, prathi okati marokati end avvakamunde start ayithe — r1.check_in < r2.check_out AND r2.check_in < r1.check_out. Rendu sides lo strict < vadadam ante, next check-in date ki equal ga unna checkout date overlap ga count avvadu, anduke Aarav mariyu Karthik (08-05 nunchi 08-05) self-join nunchi rendu candidates ayina correct ga exclude avutaru.

COALESCE(check_out, '9999-12-31'), 'inka end date ledu' ani cheppadaniki future lo chala dooramlo unna date ni vadutundi, adi porapatuna edaina real check-in kanna mundu raadu — idi e Divya open-ended stay ni, mudu vaarala tarvata vache Vikram reservation tho correct ga overlap avvanistundi, NULL comparison valla silent ga drop avvakunda.

Listing 200 result nunchi poortiga marugavutundi: Meera (08-01 nunchi 08-03) mariyu Rohan (08-10 nunchi 08-15) self-join tarvata oka candidate pair, kaani Rohan check-in Meera checkout kanna mundu kaadu, so WHERE clause vaallani non-overlap ga correct ga filter chestundi.

Mudu listings lo unna edu reservations nunchi mudu overlapping pairs vastayi: listing 100 meeda Aarav/Priya mariyu Priya/Karthik (oka three-way pileup, kaani oka group ga kaakunda rendu separate pairs ga report avutundi), mariyu listing 300 meeda Divya/Vikram — self-join inequality guarantee chesinatlu prathi okati exact ga oka sari report avutundi.
